scope: read-only production interactions; product/customer forms validated but not submitted; CSV parsed only in browser and cancelled; no product, customer, sale, refund, RFQ, or register-close writes

checks.name: Mobile navigation drawer opens and dismisses
checks.evidence: At 390px, the navigation drawer opens and closes with Escape and the outside backdrop; ARIA state tracks visibility.

checks.name: Compact account popover opens and closes accessibly
checks.evidence: Account popover opens, exposes aria-expanded, and closes on Escape and an outside click.

checks.name: Product search filters the Odoo catalogue
checks.evidence: At 390px the product cards replaced the wide table; search `shiraz` returned Barossa Shiraz only.

checks.name: Product edit dialog is prefilled from Odoo
checks.evidence: At 390px the edit dialog fit the viewport, showed the Odoo sale price 34.90, and was closed without saving.

checks.name: New product form blocks submission without a name
checks.evidence: Product name is required; empty form validation was checked and the dialog was cancelled without creating a product.

checks.name: CSV product import previews valid rows without writing to Odoo
checks.evidence: A valid one-row CSV was parsed and previewed; Cancel closed the dialog with no Odoo product write.

checks.name: Customer creation form is required-field guarded
checks.evidence: At 390px the customer dialog fit the viewport; Customer name is required and the empty form was cancelled without submission.

checks.name: Customer mobile card and edit dialog render from a read-only fixture
checks.evidence: Mobile customer card showed Odoo fixture details and tap-to-call; edit dialog fit the viewport and was closed without saving.

checks.name: Sales history searches and opens a refunded receipt
checks.evidence: At 390px the mobile receipt card replaced the wide table; the receipt dialog fit the viewport, showed the prior refund, and hid the duplicate full-refund action.

checks.name: Replenishment coverage control refreshes the estimate
checks.evidence: At 390px, replenishment showed product cards without overflow (390px); coverage changed to 7 days; no-sales state remains explicitly qualified.

checks.name: Reporting period selector reloads Odoo dashboard
checks.evidence: At 390px the reporting dashboard has no horizontal overflow (390px); range changed to 24 hours, chart marks are accessible, and the AI assistant opens/closes.
